Excellence in MP Board Education
Welcome to MGM Hr. Sec. School

🏛️ Our Legacy of Excellence

Founded in 1996, Mar Gregorios Memorial (MGM) Higher Secondary School, Khandwa, was established with a vision to deliver premium quality education with minimal investment, ensuring equal learning opportunities for all. Over the decades, we have grown into the benchmark MP Board school in the region, blending modern educational technologies with timeless core values.

🌟 Key Institutional Achievements

🎓 Academic Milestones: Consistently securing top-tier pass percentages and merit positions in the MP State Board 10th and 12th examinations.
🔬 Innovation & Science: Awarded top honors at the National Science Fair for student-led sustainable energy solutions.
🏫 Holistic Infrastructure: Successfully transitioned into a tech-enabled campus featuring advanced science labs, smart classrooms, a comprehensive library, and full-scale sports infrastructure.
🏅 Extracurricular Laurels: Routine victory tracking across District-Level Inter-School athletic meets, talent championships, and community contribution initiatives.
🎖️ Leadership Nurturing: Annual deployment of active Student Cabinets via traditional investiture ceremonies to cultivate real-world governance and accountability.
⚖️ Legal Awareness Outreach: Regular interactive sessions with visiting dignitaries from the Child (Juvenile Justice) Court in Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh, educating students on legal rights, tobacco & gutkha de-addiction, and responsible social media use through dedicated audio-visual awareness classes.

Mission, Vision & Pledge

Our Vision

To create confident, skilled, disciplined, and future-ready students equipped for real-life success and meaningful community contributions.

Our Mission

Deliver strong academics, build real-world skills, support emotional well-being, empower teachers, and strengthen parent partnerships to prepare students for tomorrow.

Core Values

Discipline • Excellence • Respect • Growth Mindset • Integrity • Teamwork • Innovation • Compassionate Service.

School Pledge

"India is my country. All Indians are my brothers and sisters. I love my country, and I am proud of its rich and varied heritage. I shall always strive to be worthy of it. I shall give my parents, teachers and all elders respect and treat everyone with courtesy. To my country, and my people, I pledge my devotion. In their well being and prosperity alone, lies my happiness."

Got Questions?

Frequently Asked Questions

What is the admission process for new students?
Admission forms are available at the school office and online. Entrance tests and interviews are part of the selection process for designated grades.
What curriculum does the school follow?
M.G.M Hr. Sec. School follows the structured MP Board Curriculum catering to the intellectual, physical, and emotional development of students.
What are the school timing hours?
Classes VI to XII operate from 7:20 AM to 1:20 PM. Nursery to Class 5th operates from 10:45 AM to 4:00 PM.
Are extracurricular activities available?
Yes! We offer sports, art competitions, fancy dress events, quizzes, and leadership programs for overall personality growth.
